cases.question: Will meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct fit on my GPU server? I want to know which NIM image and profile to use before I download anything.
cases.ground_truth: Locality first: the model names no host and the user names no source, so the agent runs nimselect.py locate straight away, asking nothing first. On a machine that reaches Google within 3 s and has no China timezone, locate gives outside_china: the agent uses NGC and says so in a short note ("NGC, because this machine looks to be outside China; say if you pull from a China registry"). On china or unknown it asks "You seem to be in China. Use TGC, TuringCM or Lichan?" or "NGC, TGC, TuringCM or Lichan?" instead, in one message, and runs no resolve or select until the user answers; the rest of this case then does not apply. The agent resolves meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct, inspects this host and runs select on the resource id with the saved environment. select checks the newest version first, then hardware variants and older versions, and picks the first image that fits. The agent reports the verdict, the chosen image nvcr.io/nim/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct:<version> with image_choice.reason, and the recommended profile id with its why lines. It asks the user to confirm the image and profile, then offers the hand-off to nim-tune for a vllm profile (nim-deploy for another backend, or when nim-tune is not installed) with model, image, model_profile and gpus. Nothing is pulled or run.

Runs scripts/nimselect.py inspect --target host --out FILE
Runs scripts/nimselect.py select with meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct or its resource id nim/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct and --env FILE (no --tag, since the user named none)

Runs no docker pull, docker run or kubectl apply
